title: US military confirms it launched space weapons into Earth's orbit | TechCrunch
summary: Space Force says Russia is currently developing a satellite “designed to carry a nuclear weapon.” According to The Times, the U.S. had long disavowed the destruction of satellites in space as attacks can leave debris harmful to other space objects and astronauts.
